Method of Attack: Privilege escalation by exploiting Windows Installer Rollback File (.RBF) symbolic link vulnerability to overwrite files with administrator privileges
Leveraging discretionary access control list (DACL) for Microsoft Edge Elevation Service to replace executables with MSI files to run code as administrator
Impacted Systems: All Windows versions including Windows 11 and Windows Server 2022
Attack Vector: Local user with limited account privileges exploiting symbolic link creation in Windows Installer's Rollback File handling
Malware leveraging the vulnerability to escalate privileges on compromised Windows computers
Indicators of Compromise: Proof-of-concept exploit code published by Abdelhamid Naceri
Malware samples reported by Cisco Talos leveraging the vulnerability
Use of MSI files to replace executables via DACL manipulation
